Hadhrat Jaabir bin Abdullaah (RA) Feeds People
His Story During the Battle of Khandaq

Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) narrates, "As we were busy digging (the trench) for the Battle of Khandaq, an extremely hard boulder became an obstacle. When the Sahabah (RA) reported to Rasulullaah ﷺ that the boulder posed an obstacle in the digging, he said, 'I am coming down there.' Rasulullaah ﷺ then stood up with a stone tied to his belly (to suppress the hunger) because we had already gone three days without even tasting any food. Rasulullaah ﷺ then took up a pickaxe and with one strike, reduced it to a heap of dust. I then asked permission from Rasulullaah ﷺ to go home and (when I reached home) I said to my wife, 'I have seen such hunger on Rasulullaah ﷺ that I am unable to bear. Do you have anything (to eat)?' She replied, 'I have some barley and a kid goat.'

I then slaughtered the kid as she ground the barley. We placed the meat in a pot (to cook) and when I went to call Rasulullaah ﷺ, the dough had already risen and the pot was on the fire with the food almost cooked. I said, 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ! I have a little food, so why don't you and one or two persons come?' When Rasulullaah ﷺ asked me how much food there was, I informed him accordingly. He said, 'That is plenty and most excellent. Tell your wife not to take the pot off the fire and not to take the bread out of the oven until I arrive.' He then told the Sahabah (RA) to stand up (to join in the meal) and the Muhaajireen, the Ansaar and all with them stood up."

When Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) came to his wife, he said, "Oh dear! Rasulullaah ﷺ has come with the Muhaajireen, the Ansaar and everyone else!" She asked, "Did Rasulullaah ﷺ ask you about this?" Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) confirmed that Rasulullaah ﷺ had asked him (she was therefore content that Rasulullaah ﷺ would make the further arrangements). (When the Sahabah (RA) reached the house,) Rasulullaah ﷺ said to them, "Enter the house, but do not crowd it." Rasulullaah ﷺ then started breaking the bread into pieces, placed meat on them and served them to the Sahabah (RA). Whenever Rasulullaah ﷺ took anything from the pot or the oven, he covered them again. Rasulullaah ﷺ continued breaking the bread and dishing out the food until everyone was satiated and there was still plenty leftovers. He then said (to the lady), "Eat from this and give some to others because hunger had afflicted everyone."[^2]
